result.brief: 提出免训练框架 PhysTrace，用 MLLM 生成历史条件物理期望并与观测视频窗口对齐，实现物理违规的时间定位与可解释描述，并构建 IntPhys2-Timing 基准，用于评估视频生成模型的物理一致性。
result.reason: Training-free evaluation of physical consistency in pretrained video generative models, temporally localizing violations; directly serves video world model and video generation evaluation.
